about: Westcountry Surf School is a brother-and-sister-run surf school in Newquay that teaches at Watergate Bay. It works from the field car park above the beach and offers free pick-up and drop-off from where you're staying. Lessons suit beginners, families, groups and individuals, and instructors film sessions so you can watch the footage afterwards.
offers: Early and late sessions for all levels
where: Field car park overlooking Watergate Bay, Newquay
goodToKnow: Wetsuits, rash vests and hooded towels are provided
Book by email, phone or online form; a deposit secures the booking
Instructors are Surfing GB-trained coaches and active RNLI lifeguards
season: Mainly summer, with some spring and autumn sessions
gaps: No age limits, what to bring or cancellation terms
